subject.title: feat(control-ui): add workspace boundary warning card with honest unavailable state

question: Should OpenClaw expose an unavailable-only workspace-boundary status as a permanent core Gateway and Control UI surface before an approved canonical-root signal exists?
rationale: This is a new public Gateway/UI contract rather than a repair to established behavior, and current code has no canonical-root source that could make the card informative.

options.title: Defer until a real signal exists
options.body: Do not add the public RPC/card until its owner can provide an approved canonical-root source and actionable status semantics.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded core status surface
options.body: Keep the PR direction, but require a rebase to current Gateway descriptors, a defined path-disclosure contract, localized copy, and focused tests.

options.title: Route the visibility need to an existing security surface
options.body: Ask the relevant security or Doctor owner to decide whether the information belongs in an existing diagnostic rather than a new Overview card.

recommendation.title: Defer until a real signal exists
recommendation.body: Do not add the public RPC/card until its owner can provide an approved canonical-root source and actionable status semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ownership could not be resolved safely enough to name a specific person.
